title: Senior Accessibility Program Manager
description:
About GitHub

GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.

Locations

In this role you can work from Remote, United States

Overview

At GitHub, our mission is to accelerate human progress through developer collaboration. We believe people with disabilities should benefit from that progress and directly contribute to the creation of it. 

 

We are seeking a forward-thinking, determined and innovative individual, who is passionate about the intersection of accessibility and technology, to help implement our accessibility strategy, which can be found at accessibility.github.com. This role will report directly to the Head of Accessibility and will be empowered to drive change internally and externally. 

 

 The successful candidate will:

  • Have a deep understanding of accessibility, assistive technologies, and the ways that people with disabilities interact with technology.
  • Have technical expertise that is grounded in professional experience as a software developer or designer.
  • Have hands-on experience using AI and automation to improve accessibility at scale.
  • Have professional experience managing accessibility initiatives within a large matrixed organization.
  • Have a proven track record of delivering results that empower people with disabilities to use technology. 

Responsibilities

 The goals of the GitHub accessibility program are to: 

  • Empower GitHub employees to do the best work of their lives by creating an accessible work environment with internal guides and support for procurement processes.

  • Empower developers with disabilities to build on GitHub by including their input throughout the development process, cultivating a culture of accessibility within GitHub, and driving accountability at scale.

  • Empower our customers to meet their accessibility goals when building on GitHub by aggressively dogfooding the latest GitHub platform and AI features to run our internal accessibility program, Open-sourcing our internal tools when appropriate, and sharing best practices externally.

  • Help improve the accessibility of open source by empowering people with disabilities to contribute, improving the availability and adoption of open-source Assistive Technologies, and improving the accessibility of mainstream open-source projects. 

The Senior Accessibility Program Manager may contribute to all of those program goals over time. That said, their initial focus will include, but is not limited to:

  • Manage listening systems including inclusive user research and feedback processes.
  • Build an accessibility community of practice within our Enterprise customer community.
  • Grow the capabilities of the open-source GitHub accessibility scanner and accelerate adoption by customers and open-source communities. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications :

  • 7+ years experience in Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR), sustainability, accessibility engineering and design, or related area 

    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Business, Sustainability, Computer Science, Communications/Marketing, or related field AND 5+ years experience in Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR), sustainability, accessibility engineering and design, or related area 

    • OR Master's Degree in Business, Sustainability, Computer Science, Communications/Marketing, or related field AND 3+ years experience in Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR), sustainability, accessibility engineering and design, or related area

    • OR Doctorate in Business, Sustainability, Computer Science, Communications/Marketing, or related field AND 1+ year(s) experience in Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR), sustainability, accessibility engineering and design, or related area

    • OR equivalent experience

  • 3+ years of relevant experience driving programs or initiatives across organizational boundaries in a large organization.
  • 3+ years of experience evaluating the conformance of web content against the Web Content Accessibility guidelines.
  • 1+ years of hands-on experience using AI and automation to improve accessibility at scale. 

 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience developing accessible web-based user interfaces using JavaScript and modern web technologies.
  • Experience collecting and interpreting data for performance metrics and compliance.
  • Understanding of product road mapping and experience working with product and engineering teams to embed new features into roadmap plans. 

We encourage people with lived experience to apply. 


Compensation Range

The base salary range for this job is USD $103,200.00 - USD $273,700.00 /Yr.

These pay ranges are intended to cover roles based across the United States. An individual's base pay depends on various factors including geographical location and review of experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant. At GitHub certain roles are eligible for benefits and additional rewards, including annual bonus and stock. These rewards are allocated based on individual impact in role. In addition, certain roles also have the opportunity to earn sales incentives based on revenue or utilization, depending on the terms of the plan and the employee's role.

This position will be open for a minimum of 3 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

GitHub values

  • Customer-obsessed
  • Ship to learn
  • Growth mindset
  • Own the outcome
  • Better together
  • Diverse and inclusive

Manager fundamentals

  • Model
  • Coach
  • Care

Leadership principles

  • Create clarity
  • Generate energy
  • Deliver success

Who We Are

GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Overview

GitHub helps companies and organizations succeed by allowing them to build better software, together. We're looking for an experienced Senior Solutions Engineer in the United States to provide technical presales support for our enterprise customer base — in regulated industries, particularly financial services and healthcare.   

 

Our Senior Solutions Engineers are responsible for the technical relationships with customers and prospects, working as a trusted advisor to remove technical objections and creatively address pain points in a customer's SDLC. They will work internally with sales and product development teams to identify solutions that meet customers' business needs and document requests to expand the capabilities of GitHub's platform.  

 

We're extremely passionate about the quality of our work. If you are technically sharp, business minded, and people oriented, you might be a fit for this role! 


Responsibilities

  • Identifying customer business & technical requirements and matching them to product solutions. 

  • Building joint customer strategies with enterprise sales, support, and customer success to encourage product adoption. 

  • Delivering live demonstrations of GitHub’s products and platform to prospective customers.  

  • Navigating complex technical scenarios to help customers migrate to GitHub from their existing development tools and workflows.  

  • Building relationships with key decision makers and serving as a customer's technical point of contact and advocate.  

  • Learning about customers' successes and challenges, sharing customer feedback within GitHub, and advocating for customer interests.  

  • Applying understanding of customer environment and goals to provide oversight and guide post-sales teams to successful outcomes.

    • OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 4+ years experience in technical consulting, technical consultative selling, or related technical/sales/industry experience 
    • OR Doctorate in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 2+ years experience in technical consulting, technical consultative selling, or related technical/sales/industry experience 
    • OR equivalent experience.

  • Experience owning all technical aspects of the sales cycle from discovery to qualification to proof-of-concept design/execution to post-sales transition.

    • Agentic software development practices and tools.

title: Senior TPM, Mathematical Software & Algorithms
location: Broomfield, Colorado, United States; Fort Collins, Colorado, United States; Huntsville, Alabama, United States; Waltham, Massachusetts, United States
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 
ABOUT THE JOB
 
The Technical Program Manager, Mathematical Software and Algorithms is responsible for overseeing the development, execution, and delivery of the Battlespace Awareness software for critical programs - ensuring it meets all technical, functional, and business requirements. Battlespace Awareness software services comprise advanced algorithms for sense-making and decision-making at tactical timelines.  This role requires an individual with a strong technical background in software development, particularly in the domain of optimization and estimation, and experience managing complex projects with multiple sub-teams and many stakeholders. The Sr Technical Program Manager will be the linchpin in ensuring that the software is developed in line with the objectives defined and is released according to the planned schedule.
 
WHAT YOU'LL DO
  • Project Leadership and Strategy:
    • Develop and maintain a detailed project and execution plan - including feature development, testing and validation, deployment, and monitoring. 
    • Establish clear objectives and deliverables for the software that align with program needs.
  • Technical Expertise:
    • Maintain a deep understanding of underlying algorithms and software interfaces for battle management, threat prediction, tracking, and classification to ensure that the relevant services integrate effectively with the larger C2 system.
    • Stay updated on the latest techniques to work with subject matter experts in incorporating relevant innovations into the project plan.
  • Documentation and Process Improvement:
    • Ensure comprehensive documentation is maintained for the project, including technical specifications, user manuals, and project reports.
    • Continuously evaluate and improve project management processes to increase efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Release Management:
    • Oversee the planning and execution of the software release process, ensuring that deployment is carried out smoothly and efficiently.
    • Ensure that all software releases meet the defined quality standards before deployment.
  • Stakeholder Communication:
    • Serve as the primary point of contact for all project-related communications, internally across teams and externally with stakeholders.
    • Regularly update stakeholders on project status, risks, and milestones through reports and presentations.
  • Resource Allocation:
    • Assess and allocate necessary resources, including personnel, software, and hardware, to ensure the project is adequately supported.
    • Monitor resource utilization and make adjustments as needed to avoid bottlenecks or resource constraints.
  • Risk Management:
    • Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies with the subject matter experts to minimize impact on the project timeline and deliverables.
    • Regularly review and update the risk management plan to reflect changes in the project landscape.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration:
    • Work with other divisions and departments to ensure software supports the program priorities and meets all integration requirements.
    • Facilitate effective communication and collaboration between the Battlespace Awareness business line and other stakeholders to promote a unified approach to program execution.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Extensive project management experience, preferably in software development.
  • Demonstrable understanding of optimization, applied probability, and AI/ML technology.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
  • Experience with tools like JIRA, Confluence, and GitHub
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to manage high-pressure situations and tight deadlines.
  • Must be able to obtain and hold a U.S. security clearance.

PREFERRED QAULIFICATIONS:

  • Familiarity and experience working with materiel leadership or mission partners within Army Air & Missile Defense, USMC Ground Based Air Defense, SOCOM, DHS CBP, or allied defense organizations and working knowledge of the counter-UAS and air surveillance competitive landscape.
  • Experience working on or alongside a team developing mathematical software, such as optimization solvers, estimation engines, simulation frameworks, or applied probability models.


We request transcripts as part of the early application process to understand your academic background and how your coursework supports the skills deemed critical for the role. Transcripts help us assess your technical and analytical abilities, complementing our interview process in which we also evaluate practical experience and cultural fit. If you choose not to share your transcripts, you will need to provide detailed information regarding your academic performance in relevant courses, including projects and coursework specifics, to ensure we evaluate your academic accomplishments properly. If you do provide academic transcripts, feel free to redact non-technical information (e.g., student ID, dates, non-technical coursework, etc.). Unofficial transcripts obtained online acceptable for this assessment.

US Salary Range
$144,000—$192,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

 

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

 

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com. 

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

 

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/. 

 

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure the responsible and widespread adoption of artificial intelligence. In support of that mission, the SMB Marketing team helps small and medium-sized businesses understand and adopt ChatGPT Business and OpenAI’s B2B solutions. We build a deep understanding of business owners and teams, shape relevant product narratives, and drive awareness, adoption, and growth.

We take a data-driven approach to understand SMB audiences, uncover customer needs, and translate AI capabilities into practical business value. We partner closely with Growth, Product Marketing, Sales, Partnerships, Product, Research, Communications, and Design to deliver a cohesive customer experience across discovery, evaluation, purchase, adoption, and expansion.

About the Role

We are hiring a Portfolio Product Marketing Lead to define and scale OpenAI’s global audience marketing strategy for small and medium-sized businesses. This leader will own how business owners, decision-makers, and teams understand, evaluate, adopt, and grow with ChatGPT Business and OpenAI’s SMB B2B solutions.

This is a highly strategic and hands-on leadership role where you will shape clear, compelling narratives that show how AI helps SMBs solve everyday business challenges. You will build the content, customer stories, thought leadership, events, and integrated programs that drive ChatGPT Business subscriptions, team adoption, seat expansion, and long-term growth.

You will partner closely with Growth, Product Marketing, Sales, Partnerships, Product, Communications, Research, and Data Science to make OpenAI a trusted partner for SMBs adopting AI and turning it into measurable business value.

This role is ideally based in San Francisco, CA, with a hybrid schedule of three days per week in the office.

In This Role, You Will:

Own SMB audience strategy and positioning for ChatGPT Business and SMB B2B solutions, translating customer needs into differentiated messaging and clear reasons to adopt.

Lead thought leadership and content strategy, using practical education, demos, and customer stories to show how SMBs can put AI to work and achieve measurable results.

Develop go-to-market programs for priority SMB industries, equipping Sales, Partnerships, and Growth teams with tailored narratives, proof points, and enablement.

Partner with Growth and channel teams on integrated campaigns, lifecycle marketing, communities, and events that drive self-serve conversion, sales-assisted opportunities, retention, and expansion.

Partner with Product Marketing and Product teams to turn roadmap innovations into audience-relevant launches, customer education, and adoption programs.

Build and lead a high-performing team, establishing measurement frameworks to assess engagement, conversion, adoption, and revenue impact.

You Might Thrive in This Role If You:

Have 12+ years of experience in B2B marketing or go-to-market leadership, including building programs that drive SMB adoption and growth at a technology, SaaS, or AI company.

Understand how SMB owners and teams evaluate, buy, and adopt software—from resource constraints and proof of value to self-serve and sales-assisted buying journeys—and how AI can improve their everyday workflows.

Can translate complex technology into clear positioning, audience narratives, and thought leadership that resonate across SMB segments.

Have built content and enablement programs spanning customer education, practical use cases, customer stories, webinars, workshops, and community engagement.

Are highly analytical, with experience connecting marketing investments to conversion, adoption, retention, expansion, and revenue outcomes.

Are a strong people leader who can attract top talent, set a high quality bar, and build new functions in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A — the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry — we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Your Role

Focused Energy is looking for a Principal Software Engineer to define and own the Core Software architecture that will operate and integrate our fusion power plant. Sitting within the Software Department and reporting to the Head of Software, this is a foundational technical role: you will set the direction for how controls, hardware interfaces, calibration systems, data infrastructure, and human-machine interfaces come together into one coherent system.

You will design and implement critical parts of the Core Software stack, stand up reliable automated calibration workflows, and set the engineering standards the rest of the department will build on. This is a rare opportunity to shape the software backbone of a fusion power plant and operate as a technical lead within the Software Department.

What You'll Do

  • Define and maintain the end-to-end Core Software architecture for the fusion power plant, including device interfaces, calibration, data handling, data storage, and HMI.

  • Design and implement critical parts of the Core Software system using languages such as C++ and Python.

  • Define clear interfaces between software, control hardware, diagnostics, plant equipment, data systems, and operator tools.

  • Design reliable automated calibration facilities and workflows that produce traceable and repeatable results.

  • Set practical standards for architecture, coding, testing, observability, documentation, release, reliability, security, and fault tolerance.

  • Lead technical decisions across teams, mentor engineers, resolve difficult trade-offs, and grow into a lead within the Software Department.

Who You Are

Must-Haves

  • Extensive experience designing and implementing control software for complex physical or industrial systems.

  • Extensive experience with hardware and software interfaces, including device integration and system-level troubleshooting.

  • Experience designing and implementing automated calibration facilities or automated calibration workflows.

  • Strong experience with data handling, data pipelines, metadata, and reliable data storage.

  • Experience designing and implementing HMI for operators or technical users.

  • Strong software design and implementation skills in C++, Python, or similar languages.

  • Ability to define architecture for complex, mission-critical systems under changing requirements and strict physical constraints.

  • Strong communication skills — you can explain technical decisions, risks, and trade-offs to software, hardware, science, and operations stakeholders.

  • Strong leadership skills — you can guide decisions, mentor engineers, build alignment, and take ownership without relying on formal authority.

  • Experience applying thorough testing, observability, reliability, fault tolerance, security, and documentation practices.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with software for plasma, nuclear power, high-energy physics, or scientific facilities.

  • Experience with real-time or distributed control systems and high-throughput data acquisition.

  • Experience defining shared frameworks, API conventions, configuration management, or communication systems for multiple teams.

  • Experience writing architecture decision records or technical proposals and leading architecture reviews.

  • Experience growing into a department-level technical lead or coaching senior engineers.

  • Fluency with AI-assisted software development, or strong enthusiasm for using approved AI tools responsibly to improve quality and delivery.

About Mitre Media

Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time.

Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect!

About the Role

As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions.

You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes. As a technical leader, you'll have a seat at the table shaping system architecture, implementing core features all while embracing an entrepreneurial mindset and a “get things done” mentality.

Responsibilities

  • Integrate LLMs into our microservices architecture for state management and real-time user experiences.

  • PostgreSQL (or MySQL)

  • Elasticsearch

  • Redis

  • Docker

Front-End

title: Annotations Portfolio Lead
description:
Who We Are

Physical Intelligence is bringing general-purpose AI into the physical world. We are a group of engineers, scientists, roboticists, and company builders developing foundation models and learning algorithms to power the robots of today and the physically-actuated devices of the future.

The Team

High-quality data is the fuel for our work. The Annotations team produces high-quality data labels to support model development.

This role is a hands-on owner for a portfolio of annotation programs: partnering with researchers to understand what data they need and why, translating that into concrete requirements and rubrics, and running the operation that delivers the data. This person will also be expected to drive continuous improvement across multiple surfaces to mature the annotations function and balance strategic problem solving with tactical execution.

In this role you will

Own end-to-end performance for a portfolio of annotation programs, driving quality, speed, and efficiency

Partner with researchers to define and refine requirements

Drive step-function continuous improvement in our operations, identifying issues and building scalable solutions

Foster clarity, collaboration, and alignment across both technical and nontechnical stakeholders, including vendor partners, researchers, operations

What we hope you'll bring

5+ years of experience in program management, operations, technical project management, consulting, startup operations, or similar roles

Strong problem solving and systems thinking; ability to identify points of leverage in a constantly-evolving system and diagnose problems with incomplete information

Intuition for data quality and research needs, grounded in understanding of model training and evaluation

Stellar communication and ability to clarify nuance, structure complex information in digestible ways, and work with remote, ESL audiences

Organizational skills to bring structure to chaos and balance needs across multiple programs

Bonus points

Experience with data annotations for ML/AI, having seen versions of this problem before

Experience with robotics, egocentric video, or other multimodal sensor data

Experience with using coding agents to fill gaps in tooling / infra

description:
SQA Integration TPM

Description -

We are seeking a technically strong, highly motivated Technical Program Manager (TPM) to join our Software Quality organization.

The ideal candidate combines a solid software engineering background with strong analytical skills, technical program management experience, and hands-on expertise in AI and automation.

We are particularly interested in individuals who embrace emerging technologies, challenge traditional ways of working, and can independently develop AI-powered tools and solutions to improve engineering efficiency and effectiveness.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.

- Strong technical background in software development, firmware, software quality, or systems engineering.

- Experience working with complex software systems and cross-functional engineering teams.

- Solid understanding of software development lifecycles, CI/CD, version control, software testing, and quality engineering practices.

- Experience with Jira, Git, Jenkins, or comparable engineering tools.

- Strong scripting or programming skills, preferably Python.

- Hands-on experience with generative AI, LLMs, and AI-powered automation.

- Ability to design, develop, and integrate AI agents, bots, and automated workflows using APIs and modern AI frameworks.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate complex technical information.

- Excellent communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills.

- Ability to work independently, influence cross-functional teams, and drive technical decisions.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with embedded software, Android, Linux, or connected devices.

- Background in software integration, SDET, DevOps, or release engineering.

- Familiarity with AI agent frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, or Semantic Kernel.

- Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), tool calling, RAG, and multi-agent workflows.

- Experience integrating AI solutions with engineering platforms and development tools.

- Knowledge of automated testing frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and software quality metrics.

- Experience applying AI to software development, testing, debugging, or engineering productivity.

- Prior technical program management or technical leadership experience.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We value candidates who are:

Technically hands-on: Comfortable understanding code, troubleshooting technical issues, and building practical solutions.

AI-native: Actively using AI in their daily work and capable of creating agents and bots, not simply writing prompts.

Analytical: Able to assess complex technical problems and make sound, evidence-based decisions.

Proactive: Identify opportunities for improvement and take ownership without waiting for instructions.

Influential: Confident working with experienced engineers and technical leaders.

Adaptable: Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment with evolving technologies and priorities.- 

The pay range for this role is $105,050 to $161,800 USD annually with additional opportunities for pay in the form of bonus and/or equity (applies to United States of America candidates only). Pay varies by work location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

HP offers a comprehensive benefits package for this position, including:

Health insurance

Dental insurance

Vision insurance

Long term/short term disability insurance

Employee assistance program

Flexible spending account

Life insurance

Generous time off policies, including;

4-12 weeks fully paid parental leave based on tenure

11 paid holidays

Additional flexible paid vacation and sick leave (US benefits overview)

The compensation and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. The Company reserves the right to modify this information at any time, with or without notice, subject to applicable law.

title: Technical Program & Quality Manager (System-in-Package)
description:
Summary
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job, and there's no telling what you could accomplish. 

The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they create the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple and help us leave the world better than we found it. 

Apple products are as alluring on the inside as they are on the outside. Inside every one of our products are some of the world's most challenging SiP designs. Imagine yourself as a select member of the team that brings these from concept to high-volume manufacturing.

Description
This pivotal and highly visible role within the DFM organization seeks a seasoned Technical Program Management (TPM) and Quality professional with experience in semiconductor packaging or electronic assembly processes. The role involves partnering with manufacturing suppliers (OSATs or CMs) and collaborating with internal cross-functional teams, including NPI Operations, Procurement, and Engineering, to optimize product design and process for manufacturability.

The successful candidate will develop and implement robust factory and quality control systems to ensure high standards for incoming and outgoing product quality. They will deliver efficient, scalable manufacturing solutions that achieve high yields, low costs, and the ability to meet critical timelines.

This role also serves as a key point of contact during factory or quality excursions, providing clear and timely communication to management, cross-functional teams, and suppliers. The candidate will proactively identify, address, and prevent critical issues while driving continuous improvement in factory operations and product quality.

Minimum Qualifications
7+ Experience in semiconductor packaging or electronic assembly processes, including SMT, underfill/mold, laser, PVD/coating, bending, testing, and other related technologies.
B.S or M.S in Mechanical Engineering, EE, Material Science or related

Preferred Qualifications
Strong understanding of product quality and reliability, with a knowledge of industry standards and best practices.
Proven problem-solving and debugging skills with a proactive approach to addressing complex technical challenges, leveraging expertise in FA techniques and commonality studies to identify root causes and implement effective corrective actions.
Data-driven decision-making, with proficiency in tools such as JMP and Tableau for analysis and visualization.
Experience collaborating with Asia-based manufacturing suppliers to ensure quality and maintain strong partnerships.
Proven ability to work effectively within cross-functional teams, promoting collaboration among diverse individuals with varying levels of expertise.
Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate technical concepts, create comprehensive documentation, and deliver impactful presentations.
Strong program and project management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and deliver results in fast-paced environments.

Pay & Benefits
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $163,500 and $246,200, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple’s discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple’s Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You’ll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses — including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits

Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

title: Engineering Technician III – Senior CNC Programmer – 5-Axis Milling
description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.
 

SUMMARY

This role develops, launches and sustains complex CNC milling processes, independently delivering safe, capable, compliant and cost-effective solutions.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Independently owns complete multi-axis milling solutions from manufacturability review through CAD/CAM programming, post processing, machine setup, prove-out, FAI, validation, release and production.

Programs and optimizes complex 3-, 4- and 5-axis milling processes using advanced G/M code, Macro B and Siemens and/or Fanuc control language; diagnoses complete process and machine issues.

Leads CNC activities for new-product and process improvements; Delivers on schedule, quality, capacity and cost targets with minimal intervention or rework.

Provides expert hands-on troubleshooting and failure analysis for CNC mills and related automation, probing, laser tool-setting and multi-axis systems.

Develops and implements cutting-tool, holder and fixture strategies; demonstrates advanced tool/fixture design capability and collaborates effectively with designers, suppliers and equipment builders.

Drives equipment requirements, machine selection, vendor acceptance, installation, alignment and qualification; independently interfaces with vendors and contributes technical recommendations to site and customer manufacturing discussions.

Establishes and shares CAD/CAM and machining best practices, delivers meaningful cost and productivity improvements, and formally mentors lower-level technicians, programmers and operators.

Partners across Engineering, Operations and Maintenance; prioritize multiple assignments, communicates technical decisions and completes projects on time and with high quality.

Acts as a role model for Machine Operators in terms of attitude, machine asset care, troubleshooting, adherence to processes and decision making.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

Associate’s degree or equivalent technical certification preferred; equivalent combination of education and experience considered.

4+ years of advanced CNC programming required, including significate experience with 5-axis milling.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS REQUIREMENTS

Subject-matter-expert-level ability to take complex 5-axis surface milled components from concept through stable production using 5-axis milling best practices.

Experience deploying processes with machine probing, parametric programming, and machine calculations.

Advanced CAD/CAM proficiency, including 3D model preparation, geometry repair, fixture modeling, and toolpath generation.

Advanced Mastercam programming and multi-axis toolpath development required.

Proficiency with Fanuc ISO G/M and/or Siemens programming languages.

Proficiency with interpreting technical drawings and GD&T.

CMM data interpretation, use of complex manual gaging.

Expert troubleshooting, mentoring, technical leadership, and cross-functional collaboration.

Working knowledge of Macro B programming preferred.

Proficiency with Fanuc Robodrill and/or DMG DMP70 machining platforms preferred.

Experience integrating CNC equipment with automation systems, robotic loading, pallet systems, and machine-to-machine communication preferred.

title: Strategic Real Estate, Portfolio Planning & Strategy Lead
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Position Summary
Anduril's real estate portfolio covers 10M sq ft of R&D labs, manufacturing hubs, and offices worldwide. As Portfolio Planning & Strategy Lead, you will own the planning process that decides how much space Anduril needs, of what type, where, and when.

You'll report to the Director of Strategic Real Estate. You'll turn headcount plans, program schedules, and portfolio data into forecasts of demand and supply. You'll measure how well we use what we already have, and make the case for what to do next to division leaders and the C-suite.

This is a hands-on senior role. It suits someone who builds their own models and can work from incomplete, inconsistent data. You should already use LLMs and modern data platforms (Palantir Foundry or similar) in your work. The ideal candidate combines real estate and financial judgment with a builder's instinct and a creative, tech-forward approach to problems that have no playbook.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the Real Estate Planning Cycle. Run the quarterly portfolio forecast end to end:
    • Gather headcount and program plans from Finance, Corporate Operations, and the business divisions;
    • Reconcile competing plans into one view of demand by division, workforce type, and region;
    • Publish the 5–10 year outlook that portfolio decisions rest on;
    • Track plan vs. actual across forecast versions, and explain why the numbers moved.
  • Portfolio Demand & Supply Forecasting. Forecast seat, office, R&D, and production space demand against current and committed supply. Quantify the gaps by market and year. Model scenarios (growth cases, program wins and losses, M&A, relocations, divestitures) and their OpEx and CapEx impact.
  • Efficiency & Utilization Measurement. Define and track the metrics that show whether the portfolio is working: SF per head, seat ratios, utilization, cost per seat, and production space relative to output. Benchmark them against peers. Turn the findings into recommendations to consolidate, densify, restructure leases, or expand.
  • Workforce Strategy. Work with Talent, People, and division leaders to understand how Anduril grows: hiring velocity, workforce mix (engineering, production, G&A), in-office patterns, and talent markets. Translate that into location strategy, market selection, and site timing.
  • Executive Communications. Build and present the decision materials that get C-suite and division-leader decisions made: quarterly business reviews, expansion option analyses, and leadership briefings. Lead with the answer, show the math, and stand behind the numbers.
  • Build the Planning System, Not Just the Plan. Maintain and extend our planning data pipeline and models (Palantir Foundry, Python/SQL, version-controlled datasets with automated validation), so forecasts are repeatable, auditable, and refreshable in hours. Use LLM-based agents to automate data extraction, reconciliation, analysis, and presentation production, and set the standard for how the team uses them.


Qualifications and Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Real Estate, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Data / Information Science, Urban Planning, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in strategic real estate planning, corporate portfolio strategy, FP&A, capacity or workforce planning, real estate investing (equity or credit), development, or corporate development, including experience leading or mentoring analysts/associates.
  • Strong financial and analytical modeling. You build your own models in Excel and Python or SQL, and can defend every number in them.
  • Hands-on use of LLMs and modern data platforms (Palantir Foundry or similar, such as Databricks, Snowflake, or dbt) in your current work.
  • Excellent communication, with a demonstrated capacity to influence cross-functional teams and senior executives.
  • Ability to travel up to 10% for site visits, stakeholder meetings, and industry events.
  • U.S. citizenship required; eligibility for security clearance preferred.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience forecasting space for manufacturing, R&D, or other capital-intensive operations, not only office.
  • A track record of building forecasts from incomplete or conflicting plan data, and explaining to leadership why they changed.
  • Experience planning around M&A integration, relocations, or consolidations.
  • Background in defense, aerospace, or another fast-growing hardware company.

title: Senior TPM, Mathematical Software & Algorithms
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 
ABOUT THE JOB
 
The Technical Program Manager, Mathematical Software and Algorithms is responsible for overseeing the development, execution, and delivery of the Battlespace Awareness software for critical programs - ensuring it meets all technical, functional, and business requirements. Battlespace Awareness software services comprise advanced algorithms for sense-making and decision-making at tactical timelines.  This role requires an individual with a strong technical background in software development, particularly in the domain of optimization and estimation, and experience managing complex projects with multiple sub-teams and many stakeholders. The Sr Technical Program Manager will be the linchpin in ensuring that the software is developed in line with the objectives defined and is released according to the planned schedule.
 
WHAT YOU'LL DO
  • Project Leadership and Strategy:
    • Develop and maintain a detailed project and execution plan - including feature development, testing and validation, deployment, and monitoring. 
    • Establish clear objectives and deliverables for the software that align with program needs.
  • Technical Expertise:
    • Maintain a deep understanding of underlying algorithms and software interfaces for battle management, threat prediction, tracking, and classification to ensure that the relevant services integrate effectively with the larger C2 system.
    • Stay updated on the latest techniques to work with subject matter experts in incorporating relevant innovations into the project plan.
  • Documentation and Process Improvement:
    • Ensure comprehensive documentation is maintained for the project, including technical specifications, user manuals, and project reports.
    • Continuously evaluate and improve project management processes to increase efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Release Management:
    • Oversee the planning and execution of the software release process, ensuring that deployment is carried out smoothly and efficiently.
    • Ensure that all software releases meet the defined quality standards before deployment.
  • Stakeholder Communication:
    • Serve as the primary point of contact for all project-related communications, internally across teams and externally with stakeholders.
    • Regularly update stakeholders on project status, risks, and milestones through reports and presentations.
  • Resource Allocation:
    • Assess and allocate necessary resources, including personnel, software, and hardware, to ensure the project is adequately supported.
    • Monitor resource utilization and make adjustments as needed to avoid bottlenecks or resource constraints.
  • Risk Management:
    • Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies with the subject matter experts to minimize impact on the project timeline and deliverables.
    • Regularly review and update the risk management plan to reflect changes in the project landscape.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration:
    • Work with other divisions and departments to ensure software supports the program priorities and meets all integration requirements.
    • Facilitate effective communication and collaboration between the Battlespace Awareness business line and other stakeholders to promote a unified approach to program execution.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Extensive project management experience, preferably in software development.
  • Demonstrable understanding of optimization, applied probability, and AI/ML technology.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
  • Experience with tools like JIRA, Confluence, and GitHub
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to manage high-pressure situations and tight deadlines.
  • Must be able to obtain and hold a U.S. security clearance.

PREFERRED QAULIFICATIONS:

  • Familiarity and experience working with materiel leadership or mission partners within Army Air & Missile Defense, USMC Ground Based Air Defense, SOCOM, DHS CBP, or allied defense organizations and working knowledge of the counter-UAS and air surveillance competitive landscape.
  • Experience working on or alongside a team developing mathematical software, such as optimization solvers, estimation engines, simulation frameworks, or applied probability models.


We request transcripts as part of the early application process to understand your academic background and how your coursework supports the skills deemed critical for the role. Transcripts help us assess your technical and analytical abilities, complementing our interview process in which we also evaluate practical experience and cultural fit. If you choose not to share your transcripts, you will need to provide detailed information regarding your academic performance in relevant courses, including projects and coursework specifics, to ensure we evaluate your academic accomplishments properly. If you do provide academic transcripts, feel free to redact non-technical information (e.g., student ID, dates, non-technical coursework, etc.). Unofficial transcripts obtained online acceptable for this assessment.

Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

 

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

 

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com. 

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

 

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

Description

About the Team

AWS Global Energy is responsible for powering the world's most demanding cloud infrastructure. The team is organized across three verticals: Global Energy Strategy (GES), which leads the development of innovative commercial structures to meet capacity demand and AWS's carbon-free energy commitments; Power Generation Solutions (PGS), the single-threaded owner for AWS power generation and energy engineering — delivering capacity solutions aligned with AWS's availability, reliability, sustainability, and redundancy requirements and managing the production readiness lifecycle of AWS-owned or commissioned generation and storage assets; and Energy Portfolio Operations (EPO), which owns Amazon's global renewable PPA portfolio and AWS CFE supply agreements. Global Energy partners closely with regional data center planning and delivery, global sustainability, and broader Amazon business units on energy procurement and infrastructure needs.

About the Role

As a Senior Technical Program Manager on the PGS leadership team, you will report directly to the Head of Power Generation Solutions and serve as a strategic partner to PGS and Global Energy leadership. This is a dual-scope role: you will own technical program management for one of PGS's power programs, while also driving cross-cutting strategy, controllership, and operational mechanisms for PGS and the broader Global Energy organization.

You will work at the intersection of technical execution and business strategy, partnering with PGS engineering leads, Global Energy Principals, Energy Portfolio Operations, Finance, and senior AWS leadership to ensure our programs are on track, our organization is scaled appropriately, and our strategy is clear and actionable. You'll engage external partners, facilitate senior executive interactions, and serve as a trusted voice for PGS in cross-organizational forums.

This role is right for someone who thrives in ambiguity, thinks big, and can operate with equal fluency in a technical design review and a VP-level strategy session.

About You

You have a track record of delivering complex, ambiguous programs at scale — and doing it with the business acumen and executive presence to bring senior leaders along. You are data-driven but not data-bound; you know when to go deep and when to synthesize. You write clearly, speak directly, and earn trust quickly across organizational boundaries. You utilize AI regularly and have experience driving AI solutions at scale. 

You are energized by consequential work. AWS's power strategy is shaping how the world's infrastructure gets built — and this role sits at the center of it.

Basic Qualifications

- Experience in technical program management, strategy, or related fields in a large-scale infrastructure, energy, or technology organization

- Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder programs with senior leadership visibility

- Strong analytical skills with demonstrated ability to translate data into strategic recommendations

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills; experience preparing materials for VP-level audiences

Key job responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Own technical program management for part of the AWS power program, including pipeline management, milestone tracking, senior leader engagement, and vendor coordination.

Partner with the Head of PGS to develop and maintain a multi-year strategic roadmap for Global Energy, translating long-term priorities into annual execution plans with clear owners and accountability mechanisms.

Lead Global Energy controllership mechanisms, including headcount and resource planning, hiring performance tracking, and operating cadence — ensuring leadership has timely, accurate visibility into organizational health and delivery status.

Develop and manage reporting for senior leadership on program status, strategic initiatives, and organizational metrics; synthesize complex inputs into clear, decision-ready narratives.

Build and maintain trusted relationships with Finance, Talent Acquisition, Human Resources, and partner delivery organizations to ensure Global Energy's full scope of needs is represented in cross-organizational planning.

Drive continuous improvement in Global Energy's operating mechanisms — identifying gaps, proposing solutions, and leading implementation across teams.

Represent PGS and Global Energy in senior forums, including facilitating off-sites, leadership reviews, and partner engagements inside and outside AWS.

Champion a high-performance team culture: model strong judgment, clear communication, and a bias for action.

About the team

The Power Generation Solutions team creates and delivers product and engineering solutions in for power and energy to help advance AWS’ mission to deliver world-leading cloud services. Our solutions are guided by four main principles; unlocking capacity growth, maintaining high infrastructure uptime, minimizing infrastructure costs, and advancing our net-zero carbon Climate Pledge. To deliver these solutions, our team provides technical input to realize a shared vision and strategy with partner teams and provides engineering support across the project or product lifecycle to deliver the solution. We also provide grid analytics and manage and develop models for determining the total energy and water use within our fleet of data centers and work with partners on improving overall performance. 

Basic Qualifications

- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

- 4+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition

- 7+ years of experience in technical program management, strategy, or related fields in a large-scale infrastructure, energy, or technology organization

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in energy, power generation, or data center infrastructure

- Familiarity with energy development, permitting, or procurement processes

- Experience in organizational planning and mechanism or framework creation

- Experience with increasing efficiency through AI and automation.

description:
Application close date:
Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!  

This role is part of Blue Origin corporate functions, providing centralized support across Blue Origin business unit teams, functions, and locations.

As part of a hardworking team of engineers and product leaders, you will serve as the single point of leadership for integration across BNS common products. You will keep the technical performance and delivery schedules of these products aligned across BNS platforms and other Blue Origin business units, so every item is delivered when it is needed and performs its function.

Special Mentions

Relocation provided

Travel expected up to 15% of the time

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Lead integration for BNS common products, including products BNS develops and manufactures for other business units, products other business units provide to BNS, and products shared across multiple BNS platforms

Integrate technical requirements, performance, and schedules across product teams so that deliverables are delivered on time and to their required specifications 

Partner directly with product leads, BNS Systems Engineering groups, BNS Advanced Systems, and development teams in other business units

Identify, track, and resolve cross-team technical, interface, and schedule risks and issues, and escalate them as needed

Report integration status and performance to BNS senior leadership, work under the daily direction of the BNS Chief of Staff, and interact frequently with the BNS Chief of Operations

Drive alignment on interfaces, requirements, and design decisions across platforms and business units

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Aerospace, Mechanical, Systems Engineering, or a similar technical field

5+ years of experience in systems engineering or systems integration, preferably on aerospace or space programs

Experience integrating complex hardware and/or software systems across teams or programs

Experience with requirements management, interface definition, and technical risk tracking

Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work with senior leaders and multidisciplinary teams

Familiarity with planning software, Jira, Confluence, etc

Ability to lead through influence across teams

Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in a relevant technical field

Experience on national security, defense, or space programs

Experience integrating products across multiple platforms or business units

Knowledge of systems engineering standards and practices (e.g., ISO/IEC/IEEE 15288) and tools such as DOORS Next Gen

Experience coordinating technical performance and schedule across concurrent development efforts

Demonstrated ability to lead complex integration efforts

CO applicants is $110,938.00 - $155,312.85

Other site ranges may differ

Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We’re seeking an experienced Infrastructure Technical Program Manager in Seattle, WA to oversee data center build projects in the US West region. You will lead cross-functional and technical teams from conceptual design feasibility through requirements, budget, completed design, implementation, testing, and deployment. Along the way, you will use your judgment, negotiation skills, ability to influence without authority, analytical talent, technical aptitude, and leadership to collaborate with a diverse set of stakeholders across multiple time zones, manage capital budgets, eliminate non-value-add activity, design solutions, remove blockers, and find creative ways to accelerate project delivery.

Key job responsibilities

title: Senior Service Delivery Engineer
description:
About GitHub

GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.

Locations

In this role you can work from Remote, Germany

Overview

GitHub helps companies and organizations succeed by enabling them to build better software, together. We're looking for a Senior Service Delivery Engineer to support our Expert Services team in solving our customers' needs. The ideal candidate will have the aptitude and passion to become a master of GitHub's product capabilities and underlying technologies. We need a high performing engineering consultant to help our customers improve their software delivery. This person will solve challenges with many different technologies and work closely with our customers, as well as GitHub's internal departments


Responsibilities

Delivery Readiness

  • Monitor and evaluate performance and support readiness in delivery quality for customers and specific internal teams

  • Share technical expertise and contribute to the success of the team by providing coaching and role readiness training

  • Continue to evolve product knowledge to prepare for new product releases

 

Customer Delivery

  • Drive services pre-sales and scoping exercises to position GitHub value drivers to customers by focusing on customer outcomes

  • Enhance customer adoption of the GitHub platform while achieving targeted average billable utilization and Customer Satisfaction goals

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, helping solve increasingly complex technical issues

  • Provide advice to customers and partners during engagements

  • Manage client expectations, scope of work, and draft change orders as needed

  • Complete service delivery engagements within time and budget, while meeting customer expectations

  • Develop repeat business by positioning the value of future services delivery phases

 

Collaboration

  • Collaborate on cross-team and cross-product technical issues by working with resources from other groups

  • Help drive top organizational priorities by working with managers, engineers, product teams, and other stakeholders

  • Engage and collaborate with other GitHub groups to gain resolution for critical, complex issues

  • Advocate for product improvements based on customer feedback

  • Build communities to resolve customer and partner issues

 

Solutions Development

  • Understand customer goals and help create tailored solutions

  • Provide technical clarity regarding an array of technologies

  • Help customers make informed decisions by weighing critical technical solutions

  • Create high-quality, reusable solutions for customers

  • Build solutions such as migrating source code from legacy systems, creating CI/CD pipelines, or automating infrastructure provisioning


Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years experience in technical consulting, software development, application security, or related field

    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology (IT), Computer Science, Engineering, or related field AND 5+ years experience in technical consulting, software development, application security, or related field

    • OR equivalent experience

  • 1+ year(s) experience leading customer projects

  • Experience in Software Development or DevOps

  • In-depth knowledge of the Git version control system

Preferred Qualifications

  • 9+ years experience in technical consulting, software development, application security, or related field

    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology (IT), Computer Science, Engineering, or related field AND 7+ years experience

    • OR Master's Degree in Information Technology (IT), Computer Science, Engineering, or related field AND 5+ years experience

  • 3+ years experience leading customer projects

  • 3+ years experience in technical consulting

  • Familiarity with the GitHub platform and associated workflows or familiarity with legacy version control systems (SVN, CVS, ClearCase, AccuRev, etc.)

  • Strong experience with AI-assisted coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to accelerate and improve software development workflows

  • Business level proficiency in German, Dutch, French or Spanish 

GitHub values

  • Customer-obsessed
  • Ship to learn
  • Growth mindset
  • Own the outcome
  • Better together
  • Diverse and inclusive

Manager fundamentals

  • Model
  • Coach
  • Care

Leadership principles

  • Create clarity
  • Generate energy
  • Deliver success

Who We Are

GitHub is the world’s leading AI-powered developer platform with 150 million developers and counting. We’re also home to the biggest open-source community on earth (and 99% of the world’s software has open-source code in its DNA). Many of the apps and programs you use every day are built on GitHub.
Our teams are dreamers, doers, and pioneers, leading the way in AI, driving humanitarian efforts around the globe, and even sending open source to Mars (and beyond!). At GitHub, our goal is to create the space you need to do your best work. We’re remote-first and offer competitive pay, generous learning and growth opportunities, and excellent benefits to support you, wherever you are—because we know that people flourish when they can work on their own terms.
Join us, and let’s change the world, together.

Equal Employment Opportunity

GitHub is made up of people from a wide variety of backgrounds and lifestyles. We embrace diversity and invite applications from people of all walks of life. We don't discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, national origin, citizenship, disability, pregnancy status, veteran status, or any other differences. Also, if you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate!

The NSO Project Manager is responsible for the successful execution of assigned Non-System Orders (NSOs) from project release through shipment. This individual contributor role serves as the primary coordinator for complex, customer-specific system configurations, ensuring all project milestones, deliverables, manufacturing requirements, and shipment commitments are achieved.

The NSO Project Manager partners closely with the Business Management Operations (BMO) team, Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply Chain, Planning, Quality, and Configuration Management organizations to manage project execution, mitigate risk, resolve issues, and ensure alignment between customer requirements and factory readiness. The role requires strong project management skills, exceptional organizational abilities, and the capacity to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.

Key Responsibilities

Own end-to-end execution of assigned NSO projects from order release through shipment.

Translate customer-specific requirements received through the BMO organization into executable manufacturing and project plans.

Develop, maintain, and communicate project schedules, key milestones, deliverables, dependencies, and execution risks.

Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure engineering, manufacturing, material, quality, and configuration requirements are completed on schedule.

Serve as the central point of coordination for project scope, schedule, configuration, and readiness activities.

Drive execution of customer-specific configurations, engineering changes, BOM modifications, NSRs, CES requests, and other non-standard requirements.

Assess and communicate the impact of project changes on delivery schedules, manufacturing readiness, and shipment commitments.

Facilitate project reviews, readiness reviews, production status meetings, and issue resolution activities.

Monitor project health and performance, identifying constraints and initiating recovery plans when commitments are at risk.

Partner with Master Scheduling, Operations Management, and BMO teams to prioritize deliverables and maintain execution alignment.

Lead risk identification and mitigation activities, ensuring project risks are proactively managed and escalated when necessary.

Coordinate resolution of manufacturing, quality, material, and engineering issues affecting project execution.

Support shipment readiness activities, including final test coordination, documentation reviews, and production release requirements.

Maintain accurate project documentation, action-item tracking, schedule status, and project metrics.

Provide timely status updates, risk assessments, and recovery plans to stakeholders and leadership.

Identify and implement process improvements that enhance NSO execution efficiency, predictability, and customer delivery performance.

Success in This Role Requires

Strong project management, organizational, and prioritization skills.

Ability to manage multiple highly customized projects simultaneously in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Knowledge of manufacturing operations, change management, configuration management, and production planning processes.

Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to make data-driven decisions.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to influence stakeholders and drive accountability across multiple functional organizations.

Proven ability to manage risk, resolve conflicts, and maintain commitments in highly dynamic project environments.
